parameters.name: BlackholeStatus
parameters.description: The action that you want to perform on the instance. Set the value to **undo**, which indicates that you want to deactivate blackhole filtering.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-blackhole-status --blackhole-status undo --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
